question: What does Section 377 of the Indian Penal Code signifies?
solution:
The correct answer is to__** Criminalize unnatural offences.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Section 377 of the Indian Penal Code signifies the criminalization of unnatural offences, which includes same-sex sexual activities.**
